The '''Skirmish at Coruscant''' was a small battle fought on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It began when [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], was captured by the [[Sun Guard]], the [[Coruscant mercenary|Coruscant mercenaries]], and a group of thugs from the [[Restricted Area]].<ref name="PMvg" />

==The skirmish==
The skirmish started when Padmé Amidala, the Queen of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], was captured by the [[Sun Guard]], the [[Coruscant mercenary|Coruscant mercenaries]], and a group of thugs from the [[Restricted Area]].<ref name="PMvg" /> When the Queen's two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protectors, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and their new friend [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], intervened, the Sun Guard and its allies tried to assassinate them.<ref name="JPB" /> Half of the Coruscant mercenaries, led by a Sun Guard, kidnapped the Queen,<ref name="PMvg" /> while the rest attacked the Jedi.<ref name="JPB" /> The Queen was soon released by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]],<ref name="PMvg" /> and the mercenaries were all killed by Kenobi, Jinn, and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who had joined the fight.<ref name="JPB" /> The [[Thug leader|leader]] of the thugs was killed in a duel with Panaka, resulting in the failure of the plot.<ref name="PMvg" />

[[File:Coruscant_sliding_JPB.jpg|left|thumb|Kenobi traveling through Coruscant.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The events in this article are from two distinct missions from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] and ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]'', both released in [[1999]]. Both games have [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|guides]] which reveal the proper course of the missions.

The portion from ''The Phantom Menace'' game contradicts the movie. In the movie, the Queen and her retinue arrive on Coruscant, meet Supreme Chancellor Valorum, and take air taxis to their destination. In the game, the Queen and company arrive and are met by a Senate Guard member, who is killed, and the Queen and Panaka must find their own way to the Galactic Senate chambers. The player takes the role of Captain Panaka.

According to [[Leland Chee]], the manager of the [[Holocron continuity database]], those events were likely not part of the ''Star Wars'' canon.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=930#15832349|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-24|time=10:48 AM}}</ref>
